findings.title: Missing assertBillingAccess on print route
findings.explanation: The list and detail invoice routes call assertBillingAccess(req.user). This route does not. Any authenticated member of the org, including users without billing permission, can read invoice amounts and status. The PR description says the route is scoped like the other invoice routes, but only the org scoping is copied. Add assertBillingAccess(req.user) as the first line of the handler.

findings.title: Amount hard-codes /100, which is wrong for non-2-decimal currencies
findings.explanation: docs/CONVENTIONS.md says never to multiply or divide by 100 and to use fromMinorUnits/minorUnitDigits from src/lib/money.ts. For JPY and KRW (0 decimals) this shows an amount 100 times too small. For BHD and KWD (3 decimals) it shows an amount 10 times too large. This is a financial document for accounting teams. Use fromMinorUnits(Number(invoice.amount), invoice.currency).toFixed(minorUnitDigits(invoice.currency)).

findings.title: Period dates are rendered in UTC
findings.explanation: toISOString().slice(0,10) formats the TIMESTAMPTZ values in UTC. For an org whose billing periods start at local midnight, the printed date can be off by one day compared with what the customer expects. Decide on a billing timezone and format with it. At least confirm that the periods are UTC-aligned. Also note that period_end may be an exclusive boundary, so printing it as 'to' can overstate the period by a day.

findings.title: Status and currency are interpolated into HTML without escaping
findings.explanation: org_name is escaped, but invoice.status and invoice.currency are not. They are internal values today, so this is not exploitable now. It is fragile if the values ever become free-form or come from the provider. Escape every interpolated value consistently.

findings.title: Missing response hardening and print-friendliness
findings.explanation: The HTML has no <meta charset>, <title> or <html>/<body> wrapper. Non-ASCII org names may render incorrectly. Sensitive billing data is also served without Cache-Control: private, no-store. Consider adding a Content-Security-Policy header and Content-Disposition if a download is intended. The PR title says 'download', but the route renders inline.

findings.title: Invalid invoiceId is not validated
findings.explanation: Number(req.params.invoiceId) returns NaN for non-numeric input. Fractional or oversized values are also passed through. pg will then throw an error, which becomes a 500 instead of a 404 or 400. Validate with zod, as the list route does, or reject non-positive-integer ids.

findings.title: No tests, and the async handler's error handling is unclear
findings.explanation: There are no tests for tenant isolation, a 404 for another org's invoice, permission denial, or non-2-decimal currencies. Also confirm that the Express version or wrapper handles rejected promises from async handlers. Also consider whether the invoice should be rendered through the serializer or a shared helper so the money formatting is not duplicated.
